## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-enhancements`, `mod-frost`, `area:frost`.

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL

## Summary

- `frost.device.PORTABLE_ELEMENTWISE_CCS = ((9, 0), (10, 0), (10, 3), (12, 0))` is the one served set for the tail RoPE, vision RoPE, fp8 RoPE QDQ and Engram gate kernels. Their plan checks compared the device cc exactly against `(10, 0)`, but the kernels emit only arch-portable instructions (fma/mul/add inline asm, warp shuffles, plain loads and stores); the fp8 QDQ uses the e4m3x2 converts, which exist from sm_89.
- The fp4 RoPE QDQ needs the e2m1x2 converts: it serves the new `FP4_CONVERT_CCS = ((10, 0), (10, 3), (12, 0))`, so B300 and SM120 gain fp4 and Hopper keeps declining it.
- Every part this PR adds was run (below); cc 10.0 was already served. SM121 (DGX Spark) was not, so it stays out of both; the gate test keeps it as a declined part, per the sets' own rule that a part joins once the kernels have run on it.
- Tests: module skips use the shared set; the fp4 QDQ cases skip outside `FP4_CONVERT_CCS`; a new L0 case checks the QDQ gate per quantization on cc 8.0, 9.0, 10.3, 12.0 and 12.1; the multi-device tail RoPE and the vision RoPE rejection cases use cc 8.0 as the unsupported sentinel, since cc 9.0 is now served.

## Why

Proposed in #1817: GH200/H100, B300 and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell were refused by kernels that emit nothing B200-specific.

## Related issues

Fixes the RoPE / Engram part of #1817.

## API and compatibility impact

No API change. On cc 9.0 tail/vision RoPE, the fp8 RoPE QDQ and the Engram gate now produce plans; on cc 10.3 and 12.0 all of them, fp4 included. cc 10.0 is unchanged.

## Testing

GH200 (sm_90), develop `4cd4e613` plus this branch (rebased onto `fa065f1e` after the runs; the commits in between do not touch the files this PR changes), CuTe DSL 4.8.1, cuDNN 9.27.0, torch 2.14.1+cu130, CUDA 13.2, `CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`, run from `test/python`:

| Command | develop | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `python -m pytest -m "L0 or L1" rope engram` | 17 passed, 141 skipped | 124 passed, 39 skipped |

The skips on GH200 are the fp4 QDQ cases (no e2m1x2 converts on Hopper).

RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (cc 12.0), develop `4cd4e613`, CUDA 13 driver R580, torch 2.14.1+cu130, cuDNN 9.27.0, CuTe DSL 4.8.1, Triton 3.8.0, same command:

| | develop | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `rope engram` at L0+L1, without the fp4 entry for (12, 0) | 17 passed, 141 skipped | 124 passed, 39 skipped (the fp4 QDQ cases) |
| `rope/cutedsl/test_rope_qdq.py` at L0+L1, with it | | 58 passed |

Per file on cc 12.0: tail RoPE 37, vision RoPE backward 29, Engram gate 22, RoPE QDQ 19 fp8 + 39 fp4. These runs also listed (12, 1) in the sets; the final commit drops it because no SM121 part was run.

B300 (cc 10.3), measured on develop `f2aa360e` plus this branch's first two commits (the third only adds cc 12.0; no RoPE/Engram file changed between `f2aa360e` and `fa065f1e`): 161 passed / 0 skipped, fp4 included; develop 17 passed / 141 skipped.

No benchmark: the Engram benchmark script asserts SM100, and the RoPE tail/QDQ benchmarks need external model sources. This PR only admits devices; it does not change the kernels.
